captions.text: Cori can write email for Maya, in her style, from her memory.
In Settings, Maya turns on Coere Browser Use.
Autonomous and Bolt are the defaults. Human Review asks before each click.
On the Cori page she asks for an email in her own words.
Cori shows his plan and starts.
Two people in her mail are called Sam, so Cori asks which one.
Cori works in a tab of his own, in the Coere tab group, with a glow around the page.
He reads her past emails with Sam, then writes in her style. The bar shows each step and Stop.
The email is in her voice, signed the way she signs.
The draft waits in Gmail, unsent. Open draft or Delete draft are one press away.
When her line says send, Cori sends.
Sent to Priya. Undo send takes it back while Gmail still can.
Cori asks before he sends to someone you did not name.
